youtube_title: Hands & Feet Always Ice Cold? Usually Harmless, But | Body Fix #44 #Shorts
youtube_description:
BODY FIX #44. Hands and feet ICE COLD all winter, and your friend yelps when you shake hands?
Mostly B. In the cold your body saves heat for your CORE; hand and foot vessels narrow.
It protects your organs and sends less blood to fingers and toes.
Fix: Gloves, warm socks, keep moving, no smoking, layers.
Red flags: Fingers turn white or blue, sores, or one-sided and painful? See a DOCTOR.
Not medical advice. See a doctor if it doesn't go away.
Source: NHS - Raynaud's / cold hands
